tools.name: write_receipt
tools.description: Write one v1 receipt for a read a gate has cleared. Authenticated: Authorization: Bearer <writer token>. Idempotent on (writer, subject, subject_type, market, rule_version, cleared_at, answer_hash). Returns the receipt.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Return one receipt by id (rco:… for v1, dec_… for v0) with the verification result (hash, id, signature) and the public key (JWK) that checks it. Public.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: Your own receipts only — the rows whose caller is your customer key — by seq range (from_seq, to_seq, after_seq) or date range (from, to: YYYY-MM-DD, to inclusive), limit ≤ 500. Authorization: Bearer <customer key>. Refuses without a key.

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: A signed statement of your slice for a month (month: YYYY-MM) or a date range (from, to: YYYY-MM-DD, to exclusive): count, first and last seq, slice digest, the chain tip at issue, Ed25519 signature by Allooloo. Authorization: Bearer <customer key>.

tools.name: issue_auditor_key
tools.description: Issue a read-only sub-key on your own slice for your auditor (list_receipts and get_statement only). Authorization: Bearer <customer key>. The key value is returned once.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "write_receipt" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
